why: Adding the short binding rule shifted mass toward earlier cuts (rank depth up at shallow depths and a negative effect in the ≤3 bin) because the insertion was implemented/parsed incorrectly: instead of merging a finite/light verb with its following complement it caused boundaries to move before or around verbs and multiword complements (isolating verbs or splitting names like “Cirque ‖ du Soleil”, “There ‖ are”, or separating verb from its object).
lesson: When adding this binding, ensure it actually merges the finite/light verb with the immediately following core complement (don’t invert or truncate the rule) and validate specifically on very-short pieces (≤3 words) and multiword names so verbs and complements are not isolated or multiword entities split.
